progress.summary: HUMAN_CHECKPOINT rejected after review notes 13-20. Graph, plus-minus branches, exact semantics, review lifecycle, and shared runtime are accepted; algebra presentation requires operation-specific causal traces, compressed contextual steps with exact drill-down, and direct branch-to-graph continuity. Publication is blocked and run-contract.kp.quadratic-operation-presentation-governance-v0 is approved and active.
